description: Modal template gallery with search, category tabs, and a grid of template cards (icon, preview, description) each with a Use button, loading templates through the template provider and always including a blank template.

parameters.name: Visible
parameters.description: Controls whether the template gallery dialog is rendered.

parameters.name: OnClosed
parameters.description: Raised when the dialog should close without selecting a template.

parameters.name: OnTemplateSelected
parameters.description: Raised when a template is selected.

parameters.name: TemplateProvider
parameters.description: Optional provider that supplies workspace page templates.
